title: Uniqueness of a Plain Suffix
statement: Let $x,u,u'$ be finite bit strings and let $r\in\mathbb{N}$. If $u$ agrees with the segment of $x$ beginning at position $r$ at every index below the length of $u$, and $|x|=r+|u|$, and the same two conditions hold for $u'$, then $u=u'$.
